findings.issue: The hub's stage-one routing prose asserts that three sources are checked against hub-router.json vocabularyClasses: the mode-registry aliases, each packet's `Keyword triggers:` line, and the root ROUTER.md intents. Two of the three hold. The packet Keyword triggers do not: 5 of deep-research's 8 declared triggers and 7 of deep-review's 12 are absent from vocabularyClasses, so a phrase the packet advertises as its own trigger never reaches the hub. skill-hub-routing.md section 1 requires the two sides to agree on the same phrasing and section 2 says registered is not routed; the sentence as written tells an author that adding a packet trigger is enough. Reproducing case: an operator asks 'Verify cross-references across the docs' (a deep-review Keyword Trigger) and the advisor returns sk-doc@0.63316 with action defer, never system-deep-loop; 'Audit this spec folder for completeness' returns system-spec-kit@0.888763.

findings.issue: review-aliases carries the generic phrase 'review request', which skill-hub-routing.md section 4 names as the failure shape: a term that also matches unrelated work captures traffic the hub cannot serve. Three of four out-of-domain prompts route to system-deep-loop with action route, ahead of sk-code, so an operator asking about a customer or marketplace review request is offered /deep:review and an iterative review loop over nothing. The same list's 'audit the diff' also takes 'Audit the diff for injection risks' (system-deep-loop@0.5912 route over sk-code@0.501095), which deep-review's own 'When NOT to Use' sends to sk-code as a single-pass review. Blast radius is bounded because the attached command policy is 'ask', so the operator is asked before the loop starts.

findings.issue: Confirmed cause of the S9-command-references battery failure, and it is not in the eight S9 scope files: the validator's gitignored-runtime-state skip list exempts .skilled/skills/.state/ and .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/database/*.sqlite, but not .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/database/, which .gitignore:431 ignores wholesale. speckit-resume.yaml:104 therefore names a path that can never exist in a clean checkout or CI, and the S9 gate is permanently red. The eight deep command files resolve every path they name; the compiled contracts regenerate byte-identical to the checked-in copies.
